references.text: Describes the destruction of cities that are made into perpetual ruins, the same fate as Ai
Joshua burned Jericho with fire, just as he later burned Ai
Describes how the Israelites set fire to Ai during the actual attack
Refers to cities built on mounds that Israel did not burn, in contrast to Ai which was burned and made into a ruin mound
The prophecy that Rabbah will become a desolate ruin mound (tel), using the same expression as for Ai
Describes the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah with fire and sulfur, as an example of total destruction like that which befell Ai
Uses the phrase 'to this day' to mark lasting memorials, the same formula found in Joshua 8:28
